description: Both Aspirin and Ginkgo Biloba have blood-thinning properties. Taking them together significantly increases the risk of severe bleeding and hemorrhage.
recommendation: Avoid concurrent use. If necessary, monitor coagulation parameters closely.

description: Ashwagandha may lower blood glucose levels, which can enhance the effects of Metformin and cause hypoglycemia.
recommendation: Monitor blood glucose levels frequently. Dose adjustments of Metformin may be required.

description: Potential interference with thyroid hormone balance. Clinical significance is not fully established.
recommendation: Maintain a 4-hour gap between taking Levothyroxine and homeopathic remedies.

description: Garlic supplements possess antiplatelet activity which can potentiate the anticoagulant effect of Warfarin.
recommendation: Contraindicated. Do not use therapeutic doses of Garlic supplements while on Warfarin.

description: Both cause vasodilation. Combining them can lead to a dangerous drop in blood pressure and tachycardia.
